title: SREV-060 file snapshot relocation copy path contract

relocation_true_path.description: Relocated true path returned from the deletion/path tree

snapshot_continuation.description: Whether parent snapshot lookup or merge may continue

contracts: File_GetName initializes output path pointers to NULL before conversion
CopyPath2 may be passed to wcslen or wcscpy only after NT_SUCCESS(status) and CopyPath2 non-null proof
Snapshot lookup must not continue with a stale previous CopyPath after relocation conversion failure
Directory merge must not continue parent snapshot traversal after relocation conversion failure
